setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step melody through a MIDI device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 on pattern degrees 1 to 4 of scale slot 1 (C major), so MIDI notes 60, 62, 64 and 65. The sequencer is stopped and the Device page for CH01 is showing. The project has never been saved under a name, so no new or newB file exists.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Play (1,8), listen, and press it again to stop. The melody is C, D, E, F: MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65.
steps.title: Hear the original melody

steps.caption: Tap K1 to open the norns menu, choose PARAMS, then MOSAIC, and scroll to Save project.
steps.title: Find Save project

steps.caption: Press K3 to open the name entry. It starts on the suggested name, new, with OK selected, so press K3 again to accept it. Mosaic writes the project file and its parameter file under that name. Tap K1 to close the menu.
steps.title: Save the default name

steps.caption: Tap K1 and scroll to MOSAIC > Save project once more.
steps.title: Open Save project again

steps.caption: Press K3 to open the name entry. Turn E3 left to the letter row, turn E2 one detent to B and press K3 to add it, so the name reads newB. Turn E3 right to the bottom row, turn E2 right to OK and press K3. A second, separate save is created, and both saves, new and newB, now hold the melody C, D, E, F. Tap K1 to close the menu.
steps.title: Save another name

steps.caption: Press Pattern (5,8) twice: the first press shows the trig page and the second the note page. Press (4,3) to raise step 4 from F to G. Tap Channel (3,8) to return to the Channel editor and press Play (1,8): the melody is now C, D, E, G, MIDI 60, 62, 64, 67.
steps.title: Edit the melody

steps.caption: Leave Mosaic stopped and untouched for about a minute until the idle autosave runs. A third file, autosave, is written. The saves new and newB are not touched.
steps.title: Let autosave preserve both names

steps.caption: Tap K1 and scroll to MOSAIC > Save project. Press K3 to open the name entry, then press K2 to cancel. No project file changes. Tap K1 to close the menu.
steps.title: Cancel a save

steps.caption: Open Save project again, press K3, then K3 again to accept the name new and confirm replacing it. The save new now holds the edited melody C, D, E, G. The save newB is unchanged and still holds C, D, E, F.
steps.title: Overwrite only the chosen name

steps.caption: Tap K1, then scroll to MOSAIC > Load project.
steps.title: Find Load project

steps.caption: Press K3 to open the file picker, choose newB.ptn and press K3. The original melody returns. Close the menu and press Play to hear MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 65.
steps.title: Load the preserved phrase

steps.caption: Load new.ptn the same way. The edited melody plays MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 67. The save newB is still in the file list.
steps.title: Load the overwritten phrase

title: Keep a named project and recover it
